submission.bindingBasis: The planning-time sourceStateDigest (sha256:e5d8008d22495e6f0f4e5c66c0ffe9377b031ca7c3970d2391e8076a3e62ce64) was captured in planning evidence, but consequenceBoundaryEvidence indicates the owner reports Workspace source identity advanced after planning. The intended consequence is to close against the exact current digest, which requires re-observation per the owner action contract.
submission.rationale: The owner action contract states that workspace.close may compare-and-close one exact expectedSourceStateDigest, and a mismatched planning digest fails not_committed. The consequenceBoundaryEvidence explicitly reports that the owner changed — the Workspace source identity advanced after planning. This means the planning-time digest is no longer the exact current digest. Per the contract, "after re-observation a caller may close against the new exact current digest." Therefore the correct action is to re-observe the current state before deciding to close. Attempting to act with the stale planning binding would result in not_committed, and I cannot infer that the new state is a semantic equivalent of the old one from the revision advance alone.
